secoes.mesesDica: From the first post to the last
secoes.exportarDica: Only what is public, to read or for another system

colecoes.intro: Posts chosen and put in order by whoever looks after them, not by likes. Only posts that are already open can go in.
colecoes.vazioCuida: No collections yet. Gather the best posts in one place, in the order that makes sense for newcomers.
colecoes.confirmarApagar: Delete this collection? The posts stay where they are.
colecoes.porDica: Paste the address of an open post. Posts from a cell, for followers or from a closed community cannot go in.
colecoes.ordemRegra: The order is written by whoever looks after this collection. Nobody sees who added each post.
colecoes.tirarMeu: Remove my post from this collection
colecoes.tiradoMeu: Your post left the collection and will not come back to it.
colecoes.sugerirDica: The moderators read the suggestion. Nobody finds out who suggested it.
colecoes.postSumiu: This post is no longer visible to you.
colecoes.vazioDonoLinha: Gather posts in one place, in the order you choose.

meses.intro: This community's posts month by month, from the first to the last.
meses.legenda: In red, the months with 100 posts or more.

busca.dica: Searches the text of the posts you can see here. The filters below keep only one kind of post, one topic or what came after a date.
busca.teto: Showing the first 100. Add more words to find what you are looking for.
busca.paraColecao: Find a post from this community to add here

exportar.intro: A file with this community's rules, wiki, collections and public posts, to keep or take somewhere else.
exportar.regra: It only takes what is public (open to anyone with an account). About people, only the code name of whoever wrote each post: nothing about who follows, likes or moderates.
exportar.fechada: Closed community: the file takes the rules, wiki and collections; the posts stay here.
exportar.montando: Building the file… {n} posts so far.
exportar.soModeracao: Only this community's moderators can export.
exportar.registro: Every export is recorded in the team log.
exportar.arquivoRegra: Public posts only; about people, only the code name of each post's author.

docs.intro: Agendas, minutes and plans the cell writes together. Every version is kept; nobody sees who read them.
docs.conflito: Someone else saved before you. The new version is above; your text is still in the box.
docs.voltou: The document went back to version {n} (as a new version).
docs.confirmarApagar: Delete this document with all its versions?
docs.quemEditou: Who edited each version is shown only to the cell's facilitators.

arquivos.intro: PDFs and images, only for cell members. Alumia removes author, program, dates and location from the file before storing it.
arquivos.confirmarApagar: Delete this file from the cell?
arquivos.pdfComprimido: This PDF stores data that cannot be cleaned with certainty. Print it to PDF again (Print > Save as PDF) and upload the new one.
arquivos.pdfPrograma: This PDF has an attachment, program or embedded action, and Alumia does not store it. Print it to PDF again and upload the new one.
arquivos.tipo: Only PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP.
arquivos.soMediacao: After 15 minutes, only the facilitators can delete.

wiki.desfeita: The last edit was undone (the previous text came back as a new version).
wiki.desfazerDica: Whoever edited can undo for 30 minutes; moderators, at any time.
wiki.comparando: What changed from version {n} to the current one

erros.publico_nao_permite: This post cannot go in: only open posts (or community-only posts, in that community's collection) can enter a collection.
erros.autora_tirou: The author removed this post from this collection.
erros.cota_cheia: The cell's space is full. The facilitators can delete old files.
erros.conflito: Someone else saved first. Check the new version.
erros.dado_pessoal: Remove the CPF number from the text before saving.
erros.nao_encontrado: Not found (or not visible to you).
erros.post_invalido: I could not find a post at that address.
erros.falha: That did not work. Try again.
